direct_queries.sql: SELECT p, c, n FROM local
SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT p AS x, c AS x FROM remote) q
WITH a AS (SELECT p, c FROM local), b(x, y) AS (SELECT * FROM a) SELECT y, x FROM b
SELECT (SELECT q.p), q.c FROM local q
SELECT inner_row.* FROM local q, LATERAL (SELECT q.p AS p) inner_row

WITH a AS (SELECT p COLLATE "C" AS p FROM local) SELECT * FROM a
